tensura.skill.air_flight.description:
Fly where you look; release in midair to hover.
*Press*: stop falling.
*Hold*: fly forward.
*Sneak+release*: fall normally.
*Scroll* (mastered): move up/down.
tensura.skill.aura_slash.description:
Ranged slash: ×1 weapon damage (×2 mastered). Needs a sword or axe. 50 aura.
*Press*: fire; mastered fires from both hands if both hold weapons.
tensura.skill.aura_sword.description:
Adds +100% weapon damage to direct physical hits for 60s. 200 aura.
*Press*: apply or remove.
Mastered: *toggle* to sustain, draining aura.
tensura.skill.battlewill.description:
Converts magicules to aura at 1:1, using 1% of your max magicules every 1.5s (2% mastered).
*Hold*: convert until your aura is full.
tensura.skill.dark_eight_palms.descripti:
Fires 1–8 aura spheres at your aim: 100 damage each, 3-block blasts. 200 aura per sphere.
*Hold at least 1s (0.5s mastered), release*. Longer hold adds spheres.
tensura.skill.death_march_dance.descript:
A swarm of homing aura spheres: 25 damage each, 4-block blasts. Targets within 50 blocks.
*Hold* to grow the sphere, then *release* to fire. Longer holds spend more aura for more shots.
tensura.skill.diamond_path.description:
+10 armor and +40% knockback resistance; clears Chill. Lasts 60s; mastered: +20 armor, +80% for 180s.
*Press*: apply.
*Toggle* (mastered): sustain base bonuses, draining aura.
tensura.skill.earthshatter_kick.descript:
Stomp hits grounded creatures within 5 blocks for 10 damage (20 mastered), knocking them back and upheaving earth. 150 aura.
*Press* on dry ground.
tensura.skill.eight_petals_flash.descrip:
20-block dash: attack damage +200; 8 petals block ordinary direct hits for 60s. 10,000 aura. Needs a blade.
*Hold 4s, release*.
Mastered: up to 8s extra charge, +50 damage/+2,500 aura per second; *press/release* again spends 4 petals to dash.
*Sneak+hold*: dismiss petals.
tensura.skill.five_petals_thrust.descrip:
15-block dash: attack damage +100; 5 petals block ordinary direct hits for 60s. 8,000 aura. Needs a blade.
*Hold 4s, release*.
Mastered: hold up to 8s longer for +25 damage/+1,500 aura per extra second.
*Sneak+hold*: dismiss petals.
tensura.skill.heavy_slash.description:
Hits your aimed foe within 5 blocks (10 mastered) for ×1.5 attack damage and knockback. Without a target, makes a short ground slash at ×0.5 damage. 80 aura.
*Press*.
tensura.skill.instant_move.description:
Blink toward your aim: up to 6 blocks (12 mastered). 50 aura.
*Press* while grounded or in liquid.
*Toggle* (mastered): improve dodging and dodge invulnerability.
tensura.skill.magic_bullet.description:
Charged aura shot: 10–100 damage (up to 200 mastered); higher charges explode. Costs 25 aura per power level.
*Hold at least 1.5s (1s mastered), release*. Longer = stronger, larger, costlier.
tensura.skill.maximum_magic_bullet.descr:
Charged aura shot: 25–375 damage (up to 750 mastered); higher charges explode. Costs 100 aura per power level.
*Hold at least 1.5s (1s mastered), release*. Longer = stronger, larger, costlier.
tensura.skill.ogre_flame.description:
Fire pillar where you aim, within 15 blocks: 50 damage, radius 4.
*Hold 5s*, then keep holding to sustain it for up to 5s (10s mastered), spending aura.
tensura.skill.ogre_sword_cannon.descript:
Piercing aura blade: ×2–4 attack damage (up to ×6.5 mastered), through mobs and blocks. Costs 200–1,000 aura (up to 2,000 mastered).
*Hold at least 2s (1s mastered), release*. Longer = stronger and larger.
tensura.skill.roaring_lion_punch.descrip:
Punch: attack damage +1 per 10 aura spent. Uses 10% of max aura, capped at 2,000 (4,000 mastered).
*Press* at a foe with an empty hand or fist weapon.
tensura.skill.violent_break.description:
Strengthen I (II mastered) for 60s; removes one level of configured harmful effects, including Bad Omen and Nausea. 150 aura.
*Hold 3s* to activate.
tensura.skill.ranged_barrier.description:
Breakable barrier for 60s (120 mastered).
*Press*: place within 30 blocks.
[5x5x5 Barrier]: radius 2.
[10x10x10 Barrier]: radius 5.
[20x20x20 Barrier]: radius 10; mastered.
*Sneak+press* at yours: remove.
mysticism.skill.cryogenic_cessation.desc:
Ice power ×1.5; physical hits inflict Chill I (III mastered) for 10s while toggled.
*Toggle*: on/off.
[Ice Breath] *hold*: 16 damage (32 mastered); 500 magicule/s.
[Freezing Point] *press*: replace terrain 8 blocks around and 16 down with ice; 1,000 magicule.
mysticism.skill.darkness_domination.desc:
Dark abilities ×3 while toggled.
*Toggle*: boost on/off.
*Hold*: darkness beam, 20 base damage, 15-block reach; costs magicules.
mysticism.skill.darkness_manipulation.de:
Dark abilities ×1.5 while toggled.
*Press*: dark cube within 15 blocks, radius 5, for 15s; 10 damage (20 mastered) and Movement Interference. 800 magicule.
*Sneak+press* at your cube: dismiss.
*Toggle*: boost on/off.
mysticism.skill.gravity_flux.description:
Disrupts one foe for 10s; range 15 blocks (20 mastered). Effects are level I (II mastered).
[Fluctuate] *press*: bob them up/down and cause Nausea.
[Hamper] *press*: apply Burden.
mysticism.skill.ice_domination.descripti:
Boosts ice abilities while toggled.
*Toggle*: boost on/off.
*Hold*: ice breath, 12 damage (24 mastered); 500 magicule/s.
